extractedText: AI Builders Digest — 2026-09-13 Report this article Ivan Chong Ivan Chong Published Sep 13, 2026 + Follow X / TWITTER Thibault Sottiaux (Codex & ChatGPT, OpenAI) Thibault Sottiaux shared a major Astra quality reset, revealing that 4-5,000 users were affected by a context management experiment causing early stops and replies to outdated messages. The team also fixed skills that triggered too often and removed badly configured engines degrading long-tail traffic. He previewed an exciting lineup ahead of DevDay: Images 2.5, GPT-Live-1, Agents API, Data Agent, and ChatGPT for Financial Services. Additionally, OpenAI welcomed Aidan and Sasha from Git AI, who built an open-source tool helping developers understand how coding agents contribute to codebases. Sottiaux confirmed Git AI will remain open source with continued investment. Thibault Sottiaux 分享了一次重大的 Astra 品質重置，揭露有 4,000 到 5,000 名使用者受到上下文管理實驗的影響，導致提前停止和回覆過時訊息。團隊也修復了觸發過於頻繁的 skills，並移除了降低長尾流量的錯誤配置引擎。他在 DevDay 前夕預覽了令人興奮的產品線：Images 2.5、GPT-Live-1、Agents API、Data Agent 和 ChatGPT for Financial Services。此外，OpenAI 迎來了來自 Git AI 的 Aidan 和 Sasha，他們建構了一個開放原始碼工具，幫助開發者理解 coding agents 如何貢獻於程式碼庫。Sottiaux 確認 Git AI 將保持開放原始碼並持續獲得投資。 [Important Insights] OpenAI fixed a context management bug affecting 4-5k Astra users and previewed Images 2.5, Agents API, and more ahead of DevDay. (OpenAI 修復了影響 4,000 到 5,000 名 Astra 使用者的上下文管理錯誤，並在 DevDay 前預覽了 Images 2.5、Agents API 等新功能。) https://x.com/thsottiaux/status/2098639827084480864 https://x.com/thsottiaux/status/2098612714704891959 https://x.com/thsottiaux/status/2098569976143806918 Madhu Guru (Sr Director, AI at Meta; Prev: Google) Madhu Guru shared a sharp diagnosis of why most enterprise AI efforts fail, pointing to three root causes: using old-school playbooks built for incremental product development on a technology that requires experimentation and invention, under-investing in evals, and building AI from the outside as a central platform team disconnected from actual workflows. His prescription is counterintuitive: embed your best AI builders inside the functions you want to transform, like building with finance, sales, and support teams directly rather than for them. He also stressed hiring leaders who have both technical depth and the ability to earn trust from the people whose jobs are being reinvented. Madhu Guru 對為何大多數企業 AI 計畫失敗提出了精闢的診斷，指出三個根本原因：用為漸進式產品開發設計的舊式方法來應對需要實驗和創新的技術、對 evals 投資不足，以及由脫離實際工作流程的中心平台團隊從外部建構 AI。他的處方反直覺：將你最優秀的 AI 建構者嵌入你想要变革的部門中，直接與財務、銷售和支援團隊一起建構，而不是為他們建構。他也強調僱用既有技術深度又能贏得被革新工作人員信任的領導者。 [Important Insights] Enterprise AI fails when built centrally without evals and embedded builders, but succeeds when AI teams are placed inside the functions they serve. (企業 AI 在缺乏 evals 和嵌入建構者的情況下由中心團隊建構時會失敗，但當 AI 團隊被放置在他們服務的部門內時則能成功。) https://x.com/realmadhuguru/status/2098448235048378456 Thariq (Claude Code, Anthropic) Thariq announced that plugin evals are now available for Claude Code plugins, letting developers run claude plugin eval init to verify their skills still work after model updates. He also shared a contrarian take on benchmarking: interpreting evals by looking only at pass/fail scores is "basically impossible" now, as many benchmark failures stem from overly strict hidden tests where the model's answer actually makes more sense than the expected result. Thariq 宣布 Claude Code 插件現已支援 plugin evals，開發者可以執行 claude plugin eval init 來驗證 skills 在模型更新後是否仍然正常運作。他也對基準測試提出了反直覺的觀點：僅憑通過/失敗分數來解讀 evals 現在「基本上不可能」，因為許多基準測試的失敗源於過於嚴格的隱藏測試，模型的實際回答往往比預期結果更合理。 [Important Insights] Anthropic introduced plugin evals for Claude Code and warned that pass/fail benchmark scores are increasingly misleading due to overly strict hidden tests. (Anthropic 為 Claude Code 引入了 plugin evals，並警告由於過於嚴格的隱藏測試，通過/失敗的基準分數日益具有誤導性。) https://x.com/trq212/status/2098531560643539440 https://x.com/trq212/status/2098490139798655427 Amjad Masad (CEO, Replit) Amjad Masad announced that Replit has acquired a business entirely built on Replit, calling it the first of many to come. He also highlighted new Routines with budgets and showed enthusiasm for the growing ecosystem of Astra 3D experiments being built on the platform. Amjad Masad 宣布 Replit 收購了一家完全在 Replit 上建構的企業，並稱這是眾多收購中的第一個。他也介紹了具有預算功能的新 Routines，並對平台上日益增長的 Astra 3D 實驗生態系統表示讚賞。 [Important Insights] Replit acquired its first company built entirely on its platform, signaling a new flywheel where businesses are born and grown inside Replit. (Replit 收購了第一家完全在其平台上建構的企業，標誌著一個新的飛輪：企業在 Replit 內部誕生和成長。) https://x.com/amasad/status/2098548464452055437 Peter Yang (AI Educator) Peter Yang shared a pragmatic observation about AI tooling: he is skeptical of "software factories" that claim AI can build features end-to-end without human oversight. After running overnight loops to build new features, he found that a single wrong assumption wastes all tokens. He also announced a clean split in his workflow: all local scheduled tasks now live in Codex, while cloud tasks are porting over to Grok Bot. Peter Yang 對聲稱 AI
